record: scene record — FINAL merged build final-clone, JOB SOA01-FINAL-MERGE phase 22. A parameterized variant of the settled phase-12 scene: identical design system and compartments; PLAN timings from THIS programme measured takes; compartment keyframes re-derived from the locked starts at the settled scene relative offsets; the merge visual adaptations (two-stage naming flip, tint, core swap, academy tag) recorded per element.

elements.decision: Dark radial void (#05060a to #10131f), A59 grammar trait 1; holds every compartment without competing with it.
EARTH ONE · STATE OF ADOPTION — the lane furniture, small caps at the top, present throughout so any frame names its series (sound-off orientation).
"1.2" at 400 px ivory serif: M1 renders the number as a monument before any commentary; the fact must feel civic, not statistical.
"BILLION" letterspaced gold under the numeral; the unit gets its own line so the scale word lands as a title.
The sourcing requirement placed under the monument it sources, on screen while the number is spoken; no spoken dateline (phase 9 prescription).
L2 carried at 96 px center frame: the mirror line is typography, not captioning — the viewer reads themselves at full size.
The rented home drawn as one bordered box labeled THE CHAT BOX: the container the whole piece argues about; flat cutout, no photo (A59 independent cutouts).
Inventory object 1 of 3; enters on its spoken word (A59 entry grammar) so sound and sight name the same thing at the same moment.
Inventory object 2 of 3; same object identity is reused in the ring and the machine (semantic continuity).
Inventory object 3 of 3; the folder glyph marks the one object viewers already understand as ownable — the bridge to M5.
RENTED stamp slams at the spoken word "rented." (19.46 s): the verdict as an object, rotated -7 deg, scale-settling; it judges the box, never decorates it.
"Nothing." at 170 px gold alone in the void: the answer to the vanishing test gets the emptiness it describes — the box has already left during the designed silence.
A gold ring draws itself (22.85-23.55 s) around the core as L8 names the layer: the piece's central concept is drawn, not just said (canon SS2 made visible).
elements.final_adaptation: The ring label flips in TWO stages, tracking the merged text beat for beat: THE HARNESS at the L8 naming word, YOUR HARNESS at the L9 claim word (P20: V1 naming + V1 claim, shown as spoken). Across L10-L11 the ring tints to the local green and the core label swaps to ANOTHER MODEL at the L11 swap word (V2 performed proof) — said=shown at every beat.

elements.decision: "THE LAYER AROUND IT" — the ring is named on screen so the diagram survives sound-off reading.

elements.decision: THE MODEL as a gold disc at the center: given, central, and NOT the thing being argued about — the argument is about what surrounds it.
The same chip, re-homed inside the ring: the contents did not change, their home did — the piece's thesis as object choreography.

elements.decision: YOUR OWN MACHINE: a green-bordered frame the ring resolves into — the alternative drawn as a place, not a product shot (no hardware photo; the claim is about location, not devices).
elements.final_adaptation: Arrives in the designed silence AFTER the proof (the V2 relationship): the performed swap lands first (green ring, ANOTHER MODEL), then the harness-as-files settles onto your own machine; exits across the payoff (L12). Design unchanged; window re-derived from this programme. (An earlier merged draft used the V1 arrival at L10, which hid the core swap behind the layer exit — caught in frame QA and corrected to the V2 relationship.)

elements.decision: Chip 1 filed as a folder row inside the machine: ownership shown as filing — the layer literally becomes files (canon SS1).
Chip 2 filed.
Chip 3 filed; the folder object comes home to a folder row.
The message as two typographic lines with "none" monumental gold: M6 — the last thing read is the sentence the objective exists to install.
WHO OWNS YOUR LAYER? + the named long-form: the bridge requirement, typography only, held for the 2.40 s tail so the tap target has time to be read.
elements.final_adaptation: Unchanged design; window re-derived from this programme total.

elements.decision: Per-line layers carry the spoken words in the lower safe zone; principal words gold at 63 px. The band is word animation (each word enters at its measured spoken instant), never a subtitle block: words appear WITH the voice and clear per line.
The ?edit=1 inspector: click any word to read its decision record and adjust its timing/offset/scale; the scene remains an editable file system, not a baked picture.

qa_frames_viewed: Viewed by the producing agent's own eyes: scene stills at the naming beat (ring label THE HARNESS at the L8 word), the claim beat (label YOUR HARNESS at the L9 word), the tint window, the swap beat (green ring, core ANOTHER MODEL at the L11 word), the machine arrival in the post-proof silence, the relay (payoff + HADOSH ACADEMY tag + L13 band), and the bridge card — for BOTH builds; plus frames extracted from the rendered MP4s (clone naming + bridge; default relay) and the clone capture's seam frame f1309. One defect found and fixed pre-render: the machine's first merged timing (V1 relationship, arrival during L10) hid the core swap behind the layer exit; corrected to the V2 relationship (arrival in the designed silence after the proof) and re-verified in stills.
